reason: Reconcile the reviewed design remediation into one atomic acceptance, plan, and validation denominator.

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Normal launch executes no Git Rust build toolchain install OS package manager Snap mutable dependency resolution or Ollama model download
AC-2: A separate warm-storage Terraform state owns only exact KMS-encrypted AZ-bound persistent volumes while compute state owns only attachments and disposable #605 resources
AC-3: Preparation produces the complete #605 Runtime Guardian ADL CSM Shepherd Vector validator driver schema fixture library Ollama and model closure with canonical dm-verity seals
AC-4: Exact Runtime and GPU AMI IDs metadata facilities libc NVIDIA CUDA and device ABI are bound into preparation authorization seals and both warm launches

AC-5: Preparation and compute plan destroy and cleanup evidence proves least-privilege IMDSv2 SSH IAM private-network deadline termination zero disposable residue and no warm-volume KMS snapshot seal or storage-state mutation
AC-6: Read-only sealed content and separate disposable writable scratch allow two launches without trusted-content mutation and exact configured models become simultaneously resident

AC-7: Each guest uses CLOCK_BOOTTIME from its cloud-init activation start to its own local_ready receipt within 30 seconds and controller-monotonic apply-to-observed aggregate service_ready meets 120 seconds or remains failed

AC-8: Service-ready cannot emit before both seals models private Ollama Guardian Runtime health and authenticated HTTPS WSS; qualification-complete separately requires all #605 Shepherd ACC restart state degradation Vector log and shutdown assertions
AC-9: Explicit gp3 size IOPS and throughput artifact-byte full-initialization and per-stage budgets make the 30-second path feasible and stale cross-AZ partial dirty or mismatched volumes fail closed
AC-10: Preparation launch one and launch two use separate single-use authorizations under one aggregate exact-plan USD 20 envelope with no retry reuse
AC-11: Cost proof includes preparation both launches EBS performance S3 snapshots IPv4 requests and seven-day warm retention plus continuing daily monthly rate and exact extend delete action
AC-12: Deterministic proof one repeated live qualification and fresh exact-head review have no unresolved actionable finding before publication

steps.action: Implement disjoint storage and compute Terraform ownership plus exact AMI KMS AZ and destroy-plan guards.
Build the complete immutable launch and qualification artifact closure and dm-verity sealed warm volumes.
Implement no-install activation service and qualification receipts stage budgets and deterministic negative tests.
Bind three single-use authorizations and aggregate cost then prepare and launch twice proving timing full behavior and exact residue.
Obtain fresh exact-head review fix every actionable finding and publish through typed lifecycle authority.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate the exact #607 design packet, all twelve acceptance criteria, plan coverage, separate state ownership, complete artifact closure, exact platform identity, timing denominators, performance budgets, three authorizations, and seven-day USD 20 envelope before binding.
Reject preparation and later implementation diff hygiene defects.
